messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem — missing spans + bad aggregation + ETL lag. collecting owners and timelines. I can take ownership of the aggregation rollout, but need ETAs from owners.

devon: can we split into 3 clear action items? 1) span instrumentation audit, 2) aggregation logic bugfix + tests, 3) ETL backfill & throttled catchup.

chris: i'll own the span instrumentation audit. i'll run a sample over the last 48h and post a diff of dropped spans vs baseline. target: EOD Wed.

anika: i'll take the aggregation fix. adding stricter null guards and an idempotent reduce step. planning to have a PR by Friday.

maya: @ops-bot please create tickets for each action and link them to the postmortem doc. include owner and due date fields.

ops-bot: tickets created — RW-3561 (span-instrumentation-audit) assigned to chris, RW-3562 (aggregation-bugfix) assigned to anika, RW-3563 (etl-backfill-plan) assigned to sam. Links: https://issues.redwood/RW-3561, https://issues.redwood/RW-3562, https://issues.redwood/RW-3563

sam: for the backfill i'll need a compute window and quota. propose staged backfill: 6h/day for 3 days to avoid overload. will coordinate with infra.

devon: note on recurrence — we saw a similar pattern 2025-11-18 (partial spans + aggregate drift). suggest adding a regression monitor and a weekly sanity check to catch recurrence early.

chris: quick findings from the audit: SDK v1.12 has a path where async flush could drop spans when the buffer hits capacity. repro snippet:
```
# repro (local)
curl -X POST https://local-trace:8080/v1/spans -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"spans": [..payload..]}'
```
PR in review: https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/842 — fixes flush ordering and adds unit tests.

anika: agg PR: added guard for null-values in grouped keys and improved unit coverage for edge cases. PR: https://github.com/redwood/analytics/pull/129 — awaiting review.

maya: timeline recap and deadlines I captured in the tickets: 
- RW-3561 (chris) due 2498920000 (Wed EOD)
- RW-3562 (anika) due 2499000000 (Fri EOD)
- RW-3563 (sam) plan due 2499080000 (Mon morning)
I'll track in the weekly incidents sync; please update ticket statuses as you make progress.

devon: adding a monitoring change: alert if span_drop_rate > 0.5% over baseline for 15m and an automated runbook link. runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/span-loss-detection

sam: infra approved the compute quota for the staged backfill. backfill starts tomorrow 04:00 UTC; i'll post progress and ETA for completion in this thread.

maya: tagging @eng-sre for monitoring handoff and dashboard updates.

eng-sre: acknowledged. we'll add the alert, create a dashboard tile for span coverage and validate once the PRs land. planning a quick smoke after deployment.

chris: long-term recommendation — introduce end-to-end trace QA in CI to prevent SDK regressions from making it to prod. adding to backlog.

maya: agreed. backlog ticket created RW-3600 (trace-e2e-ci) owners: devex + eng-ml. Closing this follow-up for now — reopen if any blocker comes up. :thumbsup:
